en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 31. Ahmad ibn Harun al-Fami (may Allah be pleased with him) said: Muhammad ibn `Abd Allah ibn Ja`far ibn Jami’ al-Himyari on the authority of his father, on the authority of Ahamad ibn Muammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of his father, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Abu `Umayr, on the authority of a number of them that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:
“He who compares Allah with His Creation is an infidel; and he who denies His Omnipotence is an unbeliever.”
